name: Thinkink Picturez Limited
about: Thinkink Picturez Limited provides entertainment services in India. It offers concept development, casting, set designing, script writing, location scouting, photography, editing, and sound effects and mixing services. The company was formerly known as Think Ink Studio Limited and changed its name to Thinkink Picturez Limited in January 2020. Thinkink Picturez Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
